## Build the course

- **Plain text:** `course.yml` and `modules.yml` hold pages, modules and due dates, all in git
- **Start anywhere:** a new scaffold, or an export of an existing Canvas course
- **Into Canvas:** `make coursepack` builds a Common Cartridge; re-importing updates, never duplicates
- **Quizzes:** checked question banks, QTI 1.2 packages, paper forms, announcements from the schedule

## Check before publishing

- **Preview:** a local mockup of every module and item, no upload
- **Accessibility:** WCAG 2.1 AA audit of the site, PDF/UA-1 check of PDFs, each finding tied to its file
- **No leaks:** an allowlist and a hidden marker keep private assessments off the public site; a leak stops the build

## Slides and videos

- **Slides:** Quarto decks in the UWRF style, added with `use_uwrf_slides()`
- **Videos:** the companion package lecturecast voices the speaker notes and animates charts on cue
- **Output:** MP4, captions and transcript; the instructor approves every word
- **One deck, two routes:** present it in class, or check it with `lint_notes()` and `build_video()`

## Get started

```r
remotes::install_github("LJKelly3141/coursepack")
coursepack::init_course("abcd-101", code = "ABCD 101",
                        title = "Introduction to Something",
                        site_url = "https://example.org/abcd-101/",
                        timezone = "America/Chicago")
```

coursepack is public on GitHub. lecturecast is private for now.
